editorial:
Imagine a tough police dog who has to trade his badge for a grooming brush. That is the wild setup here. Max is a macho Rottweiler who works with his human partner to stop a crime ring. To crack the case, he goes undercover at a fancy dog show, where he has to act like a pampered show dog instead of a street-smart cop. The vibe is silly and loud, with talking animals, slapstick jokes, and a colorful cast of canine characters. Kids will probably giggle at the goofy voices and silly situations, while adults might find it a bit much.

The acting is mostly voice work, and the human cast plays it straight enough to keep things moving. The pacing is quick, so it never drags too long. On the downside, the jokes can feel repetitive and the story is pretty predictable. Still, if you want a light family movie night, this one delivers simple laughs. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Max and his partner finally expose the animal smuggling ring behind the dog show. Max drops his undercover act and uses his police skills to stop the bad guys. The villains are arrested, and the stolen animals are rescued. Max realizes he does not have to choose between being a tough cop and a show dog, and he earns respect from the other dogs. The movie ends on a happy note with Max and his partner celebrating their win.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and talking animal movies.
